nodes.description: IERC20 public immutable liquidityAsset; asset the loan was funded with
address public immutable loan; loan this FundingLocker has funded
constructor(address _liquidityAsset, address _loan) sets liquidityAsset and loan
pull(address dst, uint256 amt) isLoan external transfers amt Liquidity Asset to dst
drain() isLoan external transfers entire Liquidity Asset balance to loan
caller address checked in isLoan modifier
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) external token transfer in pull
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt) external token transfer in drain
liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) external token balance read in drain
constructor parameter for Liquidity Asset token address
uint256 amt local variable in drain set from liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this))

edges.reason: constructor parameter _liquidityAsset is assigned to liquidityAsset state variable
constructor parameter _loan is assigned to loan state variable
liquidityAsset state variable is used as token in pull safeTransfer
dst parameter is recipient argument in pull safeTransfer
amt parameter is amount argument in pull safeTransfer
liquidityAsset state variable is used as token in drain safeTransfer
loan state variable is recipient argument in drain safeTransfer
local amt from balanceOf is amount argument in drain safeTransfer
liquidityAsset state variable is used as token in drain balanceOf
balanceOf result is assigned to local amt in drain
loan state variable is compared with msg.sender in isLoan
msg.sender is checked against loan in isLoan modifier
msg.sender must equal loan via isLoan before pull executes
msg.sender must equal loan via isLoan before drain executes
external token safeTransfer in pull can call back into pull if token is malicious
external token safeTransfer in drain can call back into drain if token is malicious

normalization_plan.reason: constructor parameter _liquidityAsset is only used to initialize liquidityAsset state variable
constructor parameter _loan is only used to initialize loan state variable
dst is recipient argument to pull safeTransfer unsafe operation
amt_pull is amount argument to pull safeTransfer unsafe operation
local amt_drain is computed from balanceOf and passed to drain safeTransfer unsafe operation
